data.name: EnrichModeNote
data.value: Enrich mode: calls are created and dispatched exactly as before, then AI fills in details that are still blank. It never changes the priority or who is dispatched, and it never pages anyone again.

data.name: MinimumConfidenceHelp
data.value: Below this confidence AI changes nothing. Leave blank to use the default of {0}%. Allowed range: 50–95%.

data.name: SenderAllowlistHelp
data.value: One email address or domain per line, for example cad.county.gov. Only messages from these senders are enriched; every message still creates a call. Leave blank to allow all senders.

data.name: MonthlyTokenCapHelp
data.value: Optional limit inside your department's Enhanced AI budget. Leave blank for no separate limit. Used this month: {0} tokens.

data.name: AuditRetentionDaysHelp
data.value: Between 30 and 1,095 days. Older activity is removed automatically.

data.name: Conflict
data.value: Another administrator changed these settings. Review the current values and save again.

data.name: ErrorConfidence
data.value: Minimum confidence must be between 50% and 95%.

data.name: ErrorRetention
data.value: Keep activity for must be between 30 and 1,095 days.

data.name: ErrorCap
data.value: The monthly token limit must be between 8,192 and 50,000,000.

data.name: ErrorAllowlist
data.value: Each allowed sender must be an email address or a domain.

data.name: ActivityNote
data.value: Only outcomes are kept here, never the message or the AI's reply. Open a call to see what was filled in.

data.name: RejectedHelp
data.value: Rejected counts values the AI returned that were not allowed or did not appear in the message.
